# Projectile motion simulator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/projectile-motion/

Explore ideal projectile trajectories with a launch speed, angle and height. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare the range of a 20 m/s launch at 30° and 45° with the same starting height.

## Limits and checks

The model ignores air resistance and wind and assumes constant gravity. It is an educational simulation, not targeting or real-world safety guidance.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
